# Sudoku Project Instructions

This is a Flask Sudoku game project.

I am learning Python full stack development, so please keep the code simple and easy to understand.

## Coding style

- Use Python and Flask.
- Keep functions small and understandable.
- Use meaningful variable names.
- Avoid unnecessary complicated code.
- Add comments when the logic is difficult to understand.
- Keep frontend HTML, CSS and JavaScript organized.
- Reuse functions instead of writing the same code multiple times.
- Handle errors properly.

## Sudoku requirements

The final application should have:

- Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty levels.
- Different numbers of prefilled cells for each difficulty.
- Exactly one solution for every generated puzzle.
- Prefilled cells cannot be changed.
- Invalid moves should give immediate visual feedback.
- A Check button.
- A Hint button.
- A timer.
- A completion message.
- A Top 10 scoreboard.
- Player name, time, difficulty and number of hints in the scoreboard.
- Top 10 scores saved using browser localStorage.
- Dark mode.
- Responsive design for desktop and mobile.
- Different colors for the 3x3 Sudoku sections.
- Good readability in light and dark mode.

## Testing

- Use pytest for Python tests.
- Tests should be easy to understand.
- Run tests after making important changes.
- Do not remove working tests just to make the test suite pass.

## Copilot behavior

When suggesting code, explain what the code does if it is not obvious.

Do not make large unrelated changes.

If there are multiple ways to solve something, prefer the simpler solution.

I will review the suggestions before accepting them.
